title: Prefix and optional separator decomposition
statement: Every finite Boolean word $w$ can be written as a string of $p$ true bits, followed by either no separator or one false bit, followed by a remaining Boolean word; that is, there exist $p\in\mathbb{N}$ and an optional word $z$ such that $w=\mathrm{true}^p$ followed by the optional false separator and then $z$.
